[[Eye of the North]] | pvp = Animal (also [[PvP reward]]) | specialgallery = mesmer Animal Mask }} The '''Mesmer Animal Mask''' is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign and Eye of the North expansion. This mask is available with a [[Inspiration Magic]] [[attribute bonus]] for all masks with lower than max [[armor rating]].
